films.title: Miraculous World: Shanghai - The Legend of Ladydragon
films.overview: On school break, Marinette heads to Shanghai to meet Adrien. But after arriving, Marinette loses all her stuff, including the Miraculous that allows her to turn into Ladybug!

films.title: Miraculous World: London, at the Edge of Time
films.overview: To save the future from a terrible fate, Marinette becomes Chronobug and teams up with Bunnyx to defeat a mysterious opponent who travels through time.

films.title: Miraculous World: Paris, Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir
films.overview: Ladybug and Cat Noir discover the existence of a parallel universe in which they're supervillains determined to seize the Butterfly Miraculous.

films.title: Miraculous World: New York, United HeroeZ
films.overview: Marinette's class is headed to New York, the city of superheroes, for French-American Friendship Week. But the arrival of Hawk Moth will complicate everything.
